items.headline: Polymarket US tiers its taker fee by volume: 9.5% for accounts under $10,000 a month, 6.95% only above $250,000 and for a new account's first week
items.number: A 37% fee increase for the ordinary account: $1.74 → $2.38 on 100 shares at 50¢; break-even 51.7% → 52.4%.

items.headline: DOJ indictment and CFTC complaint over Polymarket trades on the Maduro operation using classified information
items.source_name: Mondaq, 5 May 2026 (CFTC v. Van Dyke; U.S. v. Van Dyke)
items.number: Alleged profit: more than $400,000, placed hours before the operation. Every dollar of it came from the accounts on the other side.

items.headline: Wisconsin's attorney general sues Kalshi, Polymarket, Robinhood, Coinbase and Crypto.com over sports event contracts
items.number: Sports is 59% of the market series on both venues in our index (7,760 of 13,182 pages). A ruling against sports contracts would touch most of what is traded.

items.headline: Kalshi suspends three political candidates for five years for trading on their own races
items.source_name: Mondaq, 5 May 2026 (Kalshi files KDA-2026-0004, KDA-2026-0005, KE-2026-0003)
items.number: Positions of about $50 to a few hundred dollars; fines of $540 to $6,229 plus disgorgement. The sums were small; the rule is not.

items.headline: Kalshi removes all its affiliate badges on X after X bars paid affiliate accounts from posting gambling content
items.number: Category economics (iGB Affiliate, Nov 2025): about $100 per new trader to the publisher who sends them. Our referral links, if any, live only on this site, under the disclosure.
